clean_text: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious , the Most Merciful. Praise be to Allah , and peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger. O Allah, send peace, blessings, and grace upon our Prophet Muhammad, and upon all his family and companions. To proceed: It is narrated from Abu Sa'id and Abu Hurairah, may Allah be pleased with them , that the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: "When the people of Paradise enter Paradise, a caller will call out: 'You shall live and never die, you shall be healthy and never fall ill, and you shall remain young and never grow old.'" "And you shall live in bliss and never face misery." Reported by Muslim. In Sahih Muslim, from Abu Hurairah and Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. And Allah knows best, and may peace and blessings be upon our Prophet Muhammad.

summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour presents a hadith from Sahih Muslim regarding the eternal blessings of Paradise. The hadith, narrated by Abu Sa'id and Abu Hurairah, quotes the Prophet Muhammad describing what a caller will announce to the inhabitants of Paradise: they will live eternally without death, maintain perfect health without illness, remain forever young without aging, and experience perpetual bliss without suffering. This hadith emphasizes the incomparable rewards and comforts promised to the believers in the afterlife.
suggested_title: The Eternal Blessings of Paradise - A Hadith from Sahih Muslim
